select.title: Choose a persona
select.lead: You post, join and follow as the persona you pick. Switch any time from the sidebar.
select.emptyBody: Log in again to get your default persona.

public.label: Public
public.note: Everyone sees this persona and can follow it at once.

private.label: Private
private.note: Others see an anonymous name until you approve them as followers.

only_me.label: Only me
only_me.note: Only you see it. Nobody can follow it.

privacy.hintLeavesProfile: It will no longer show on your profile.
privacy.hintLeavesPrivate: Your follow-request link stops working and your pending invitations are cancelled. Your followers stay.
privacy.showOnProfileNote: Your linked personas list each other, with this persona's label, for anyone who visits them.

manager.title: Personas
manager.lead: Each persona is a facet of you, with its own name, theme and followers. People follow a persona, not you.
manager.emptyBody: A persona is how you show up in channels and communities.
manager.notFoundBody: It doesn't exist, or it isn't one of yours.

basics.title: Basics
basics.lead: How this persona shows up to others.

look.title: Look
look.lead: Your profile's colours and cover. The preview changes as you pick.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Privacy decides what others see of this persona, not what it can do.

interests.title: Interests
interests.lead: Only you see this persona's interests. They shape your suggestions.

settings.saveFailed: Couldn't save the persona. Please try again.

slug.help: 3–50 lowercase letters, digits or single hyphens.
slug.taken: Another of your personas already uses this handle.

photo.hint: Without a photo, your initials show.

fields.label: Label
fields.labelHelper: Only you see this. It tells your personas apart.

followLink.resetConfirm: Reset the link? The old link will stop working.
followLink.title: Follow-request link
followLink.hint: Anyone with the link can ask to follow. Reset stops the old link working.
followLink.dialogLead: Anyone with this link can ask to follow you. You approve each request.
followLink.invalid: This link is no longer valid
followLink.logIn: Log in to request to follow

wizard.changeAnyTime: You can change this any time.
wizard.basicsLead: How this persona looks to others.
wizard.createFailed: Couldn't create the persona. Please try again.
wizard.interestsFailed: The persona was created, but its interests weren't saved. Please try again.
wizard.interestsLead: Pick at least one. They shape what this persona is shown.

follow.unfollowPrivateConfirm: Unfollow {{name}}? {{name}} is private, so you'll lose access and have to request again.
follow.revealConfirmNamed: Follow {{name}}? {{name}} will see who you are.
follow.revealConfirm: Follow this persona? It will see who you are.

invite.cancelConfirm: Cancel your invitation to this persona?
invite.bannerBody: Accept to follow them. They already see who you are.

locked.title: This persona is private
locked.body: Follow it to see its profile.

profile.lockedFacts: Request to follow to see their profile and posts.
profile.channelsOwnEmptyBody: Channels you join show up here.
profile.channelsEmptyBody: Not in any channels you can see.
profile.notFoundBody: It doesn't exist, or it isn't visible to you.
profile.privateBody: They see your persona when you ask to follow. Once they approve, the full profile appears here.

followers.lead: Approve follow requests, and remove followers.
